name: Roflumilast
route_note: Oral tablet once daily for COPD; cream or foam once daily for psoriasis, atopic dermatitis and seborrhoeic dermatitis
owner: AstraZeneca (oral, US); Arcutis (topical Zoryve); generics available

discovery.note: A benzamide PDE4 inhibitor optimised for oral once-daily dosing.

tagline: Oral PDE4 inhibitor that cuts COPD exacerbations; topical form for psoriasis
summary: Roflumilast is a selective PDE4 inhibitor with anti-inflammatory effects. Orally it reduces exacerbations in severe COPD with chronic bronchitis, and topical formulations are approved for plaque psoriasis, atopic dermatitis and seborrhoeic dermatitis.
mechanism: PDE4 is the main enzyme that degrades cyclic AMP in neutrophils, macrophages, T cells and airway epithelial cells. Roflumilast and its active N-oxide metabolite inhibit PDE4, raising intracellular cAMP.
Higher cAMP suppresses release of inflammatory mediators such as TNF-α and IL-17 and reduces neutrophilic inflammation. Roflumilast has no direct bronchodilator effect.
uses: Reduction of exacerbations in severe COPD associated with chronic bronchitis and a history of exacerbations

history.title: EU approval
history.detail: Daxas is approved in the European Union for severe COPD.

history.title: US approval
history.detail: FDA approves Daliresp for reducing COPD exacerbations.

history.title: Topical psoriasis
history.detail: FDA approves Zoryve (roflumilast) cream 0.3% for plaque psoriasis.

history.title: Seborrhoeic dermatitis
history.detail: FDA approves Zoryve foam 0.3% for seborrhoeic dermatitis.

history.title: Atopic dermatitis
history.detail: FDA approves Zoryve cream 0.15% for mild to moderate atopic dermatitis.

pk.metabolism: CYP3A4 and CYP1A2 to active roflumilast N-oxide

serious: Interactions with strong CYP inducers or inhibitors

facts: Roflumilast N-oxide accounts for most of the PDE4 inhibition in vivo.
Apremilast, another PDE4 inhibitor, is used orally for psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis.
